benchmark_target_summary.dataset_split: TFDS MovieLens 100K ratings shuffled with seed 42 and reshuffle_each_iteration=false; first 80,000 interactions train, remaining 20,000 test
benchmark_target_summary.method_config: Two-tower user/movie-title retrieval model; 32-dimensional embeddings; FactorizedTopK over all 1,682 movie-title candidates; Adagrad learning rate 0.1; train batch 8,192; test batch 4,096; 3 epochs
protocol_caveats: The tutorial uses an interaction-random 80/20 split rather than a temporal split.
Evaluation searches the entire movie candidate set but does not exclude previously watched movies; the tutorial explicitly warns that seen movies can crowd out test positives.
The metric is true-candidate top-k categorical accuracy, not v5 HR/NDCG/GAUC, and the result is reference-only.
The tutorial was last updated 2023-05-27; its exact binding to release v0.7.3 and full commit 7caed557b9d5194202d8323f2d4795231a5d0b1d was not replayed.
